metadata.description: A Unique name used for the Virtual Machine domain and also for generating resource names. Defaults to a value prefixed with "aiovm-".
Type of authentication to use on the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
SSH key or password for the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
The size of the VM, at least 16GB RAM is required

variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true

apt:
  preserve_sources_list: true
  sources:
    msft.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://packages.microsoft.com/ubuntu/24.04/prod noble main'
      keyid: BC528686B50D79E339D3721CEB3E94ADBE1229CF
    azurecli.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/azure-cli noble main'
      keyid: BC528686B50D79E339D3721CEB3E94ADBE1229CF
    kubernetes.list:
      source: 'deb [signed-by=$KEY_FILE] https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/ /'
      keyid: DE15B14486CD377B9E876E1A234654DA9A296436

packages:
  - azure-cli
  - kubectl
  - git
  - moby-cli
  - moby-engine

write_files:
  - path: /etc/motd
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      ******************************************************
      *       Provisioning Started - Please Wait           *
      *    System configuration is underway              *
      ******************************************************

runcmd:
  # Set environment variables for later use.
  - MYUSER=`id -un 1000`
  - MYHOME=`eval echo ~$MYUSER`
  - MYWORK=/workspaces
  - LOCATION={{{location}}}
  - RESOURCE_GROUP={{{resource_group}}}
  - RESOURCE_NAME={{{resource_name}}}

  # -------------------------
  # Step 1 of 8: Install prerequisites.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 1 of 8: Installing prerequisites             *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    # Install docker if not on WSL (or if missing).
    SYSTEM_NAME=$(uname -r)
    if [[ "$SYSTEM_NAME" != *"microsoft"* || "$SYSTEM_NAME" != *"WSL"* ]]; then
      if ! which docker > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y docker.io
      fi
    fi

    # Install k3d if not present.
    if ! which k3d > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      wget -q -O - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k3d-io/k3d/main/install.sh | bash
    fi

    # Install helm if not present.
    if ! which helm > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash
    fi

    # Install step CLI if not present.
    if ! which step > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      wget -q https://github.com/smallstep/cli/releases/download/v0.28.0/step-cli_amd64.deb -P /tmp
      sudo dpkg -i /tmp/step-cli_amd64.deb
    fi

    # Install az CLI if not present; then install the AKS CLI.
    if ! which az > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
      az aks install-cli
    fi

    # Install/upgrade extensions.
    az extension add --upgrade --name azure-iot-ops
    az extension add --upgrade --name connectedk8s

    # Install k9s if not present.
    if ! which k9s > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      wget -q https://github.com/derailed/k9s/releases/latest/download/k9s_linux_amd64.deb -P /tmp
      sudo dpkg -i /tmp/k9s_linux_amd64.deb
    fi

  # -------------------------
  # Step 2 of 8: Create k3d cluster.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 2 of 8: Creating k3d cluster                *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  (Setting forwarded ports and registry)          *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    # Delete any existing k3d cluster (ignore errors if none exist).
    k3d cluster delete || true

    # Create a new k3d cluster with port forwarding and a local registry.
    k3d cluster create \
      -p '1883:1883@loadbalancer' \
      -p '8883:8883@loadbalancer' \
      -p '8884:8884@loadbalancer' \
      --registry-create k3d-registry.localhost:127.0.0.1:5000 \
      --wait

    # Set default Kubernetes context to use the 'azure-iot-operations' namespace.
    kubectl config set-context k3d-k3s-default --namespace=azure-iot-operations

  # -------------------------
  # Step 3 of 8: Arc-enable the Kubernetes cluster.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 3 of 8: Arc-enabling Kubernetes cluster...   *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    # Since managed identity is used, this runs without prompting.
    az login --identity
    az connectedk8s connect --name $RESOURCE_NAME --location $LOCATION --resource-group $RESOURCE_GROUP --kube-config .kube/config

  # -------------------------
  # Step 4 of 8: Create Storage Account.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    # Derive resource names.
    STORAGE_ACCOUNT="st$(echo $RESOURCE_NAME | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-18)"
    STORAGE_ACCOUNT=${STORAGE_ACCOUNT:0:24}

    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 4 of 8: Creating Storage Account             *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  Resource Details:                                 *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*    Storage Account: $STORAGE_ACCOUNT               *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    # Create storage account if it doesn't exist.
    az storage account show --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" &> /dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "Creating storage account $STORAGE_ACCOUNT..."
      az storage account create --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --location "$LOCATION" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --enable-hierarchical-namespace true --sku Standard_RAGRS --kind StorageV2 --output none
    else
      echo "Storage account $STORAGE_ACCOUNT already exists."
    fi

    SA_RESOURCE_ID=$(az storage account show --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)

  # -------------------------
  # Step 5 of 8: Create Schema Registry.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    # Derive schema registry names.
    SCHEMA_REGISTRY="sr$(echo $RESOURCE_NAME | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-18)"
    SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE="srn$(echo $RESOURCE_NAME | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-18)"

    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 5 of 8: Creating Schema Registry             *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  Resource Details:                                 *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*    Schema Registry: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY               *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*    Registry Namespace: $SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE  *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    # Create schema registry if it doesn't exist.
    az iot ops schema registry show --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" &> /dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "Creating schema registry $SCHEMA_REGISTRY..."
      az iot ops schema registry create --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --registry-namespace "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" --sa-resource-id "$SA_RESOURCE_ID" --output none
    else
      echo "Schema registry $SCHEMA_REGISTRY already exists."
    fi

  # -------------------------
  # Step 6 of 8: Initialize IoT Operations.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 6 of 8: Initializing IoT Operations          *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  Running: az iot ops init --cluster \"$RESOURCE_NAME\" --resource-group \"$RESOURCE_GROUP\"  *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    az iot ops show --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" &> /dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      az iot ops init --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP"
    else
      echo "IoT Operations already initialized on cluster $RESOURCE_NAME."
    fi

  # -------------------------
  # Step 7 of 8: Create IoT Operations instance.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    SR_RESOURCE_ID=$(az iot ops schema registry show --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)
    INSTANCE_NAME="${RESOURCE_NAME}-instance"

    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 7 of 8: Creating IoT Operations instance       *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  Running: az iot ops create --cluster \"$RESOURCE_NAME\" " >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --resource-group \"$RESOURCE_GROUP\"         *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --name \"$INSTANCE_NAME\"                      *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --sr-resource-id \"$SR_RESOURCE_ID\"           *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-frontend-replicas 1                 *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-frontend-workers 1                  *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-backend-part 1                     *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-backend-workers 1                  *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-backend-rf 2                       *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*           --broker-mem-profile Low                    *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    az iot ops show --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$INSTANCE_NAME" &> /dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      az iot ops create --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$INSTANCE_NAME" --sr-resource-id "$SR_RESOURCE_ID" --broker-frontend-replicas 1 --broker-frontend-workers 1 --broker-backend-part 1 --broker-backend-workers 1 --broker-backend-rf 2 --broker-mem-profile Low --output none
    else
      echo "IoT Ops instance $INSTANCE_NAME already exists."
    fi

  # -------------------------
  # Step 8 of 8: Configure kube config and finalize provisioning.
  # -------------------------
  - |
    echo "******************************************************" > /etc/motd
    echo "*  Step 8 of 8: Configuring kube config and Finalizing *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "*  Provisioning complete.                           *" >> /etc/motd
    echo "******************************************************" >> /etc/motd

    install -D -o $MYUSER -g $MYUSER -m 600 $MYWORK/.kube/config $MYHOME/.kube/config
    chown -R $MYUSER:$MYUSER $MYWORK
